title: Doughnut
description: Combining Bedrockified and Realistic Styles into one modpack!
body:
Doughnut is another vanilla+ modpack that aims to achieve a Bedrockified style of animation with realistic visuals using Distant Horizons. While many other modpacks achieve this by overhauling either Bedrock or Realistic style, Doughnut takes a unique approach by seamlessly integrating both styles.

This entire idea began after seeing haimcyfly's [Stay True](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/stay-true) texture pack.
